title: Actor Web App configuration
description: Choose the Actor and presentation settings for the generated app.

title.title: App title
title.description: Optional title shown to end users.

description.title: App description
description.description: Optional short explanation of the app.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Control the app identity, accent color, theme, and Apify field visibility.

logoUrl.title: Logo URL
logoUrl.description: Optional HTTPS image URL shown in the app header.

accentColor.title: Accent color
accentColor.description: Six-digit hexadecimal color used for actions and highlights.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose the visual style of the generated app.

hideApifyTechnicalFields.title: Hide Apify technical fields
hideApifyTechnicalFields.description: Hide common platform and runtime fields from the generated form.

input.title: Input display
input.description: Choose how much of the target Actor input schema is shown to end users.

showAdvancedFields.title: Show advanced fields
showAdvancedFields.description: Show optional fields that are commonly used for advanced runs.

output.title: Output display
output.description: Choose which result views and exports are available after a run.

showTable.title: Show results table
showTable.description: Display a preview of the target Actor's default Dataset.

allowCsv.title: Allow CSV export
allowCsv.description: Add a CSV download action for the target Dataset.

allowJson.title: Allow JSON export
allowJson.description: Add a JSON download action for the target Dataset.

maxPreviewRows.title: Maximum preview rows
maxPreviewRows.description: Number of Dataset rows shown in the table, from 1 to 500.
